# Support for DecisionPilot AI

Thank you for using **DecisionPilot AI**!

## Getting Help

- 📖 **Documentation**: Browse the online [GitHub Pages Technical Portal](https://nguyentribaothang.github.io/DecisionPilotAI/) (with dedicated Home Portal and paginated chapter guides) or inspect Markdown references in [`docs/`](../docs/), including [System Architecture](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [Data Dictionary](../docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md), [API Reference](../docs/API.md), and [Verification Report](../docs/VERIFICATION.md).
- 💬 **GitHub Discussions**: Ask architectural questions, share business use cases, and propose ideas.
- 🐛 **GitHub Issues**: Report confirmed bugs or submit concrete feature requests using our templates.
